example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি সরাসরি বলো, বাঁকা কথা বলো না।
এই বাঁকা কথা দিয়ে কিছু বোঝানো যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't speak in crooked words; just say it directly.
His twisted speech made it hard to understand the point.
note: Refers to indirect or insincere manner of speaking in everyday Bengali discourse.
